name: Cross-border transfer rail
looks: A thin horizontal rail connects a 'sent' currency dot on the left to a 'received' currency dot on the right. A puck travels from one dot to the other along the rail, and below it a two-line payoff types in: a bold claim with a dimmer rebuttal of the old way.
build: An SVG or DOM line with two fixed end dots labelled above/below; the puck is a circle tweened along the line's x-axis, power2.inOut, with a soft ring pulse on arrival. The payoff text uses list-stack-reveal underneath, synced to the puck's landing.
sound: A soft whoosh as the puck travels, a tick on arrival, and a beat under the payoff line.
prompt: Show two currencies or states as labelled points on a line, with a single marker travelling from one to the other to dramatise an instant transfer. Land the payoff underneath as a two-line claim: the fast way in full brightness, the slow old way dimmed beside it.
